Petitioners through the medium of this petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeks following relief:
i. Commanding the respondents not to interfere by any means or from constructing any road or making use of land of the petitioners measuring 04 Kanals and 02 Marlas Hukam Chand Basotra S/O Assanand vs Ut Of J & K Through Its Commissioner on 18 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/158471902/
1 falling under Khasra No. 1170/877 & 1039-min/878 situated at Ward No. 5, Village Lakhri, Tehsil Ramkote, District Kathua.

ii . Commanding the respondents to take the possession of the land of the petitioner only if it comes under the original alignment of Dhar Road to Luggad Mohalla via SC Mohalla Ontha road in Ucha Pind Panchayat and that too after initiating the acquisition proceedings as per the mandate enshrined under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

iii. Commanding the respondents particularly Respondents 3 & 4 to construct the road from Dhar Road to Luggad Mohalla via SC Mohalla Ontha Panchayat Ucha Pind, Ramkote, Billawar strictly as per the allotment dated 14.08.2023.
2.

entities.text: SC Mohalla Ontha Panchayat Ucha Pind
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: This Court, vide order dated 15.11.2023 directed Mr. Ravinder Gupta, learned AAG to have instructions in the matter.

Today, when the matter is taken up, Mr. Gupta has produced a copy of communication dated 16.11.2023, issued by the Office of The Executive Engineer, PWD (R&B) Division, Hiranagar which has been placed on record, wherein it is submitted that the work of road from Dhar road to Luggal Mohalla via SC Mohalla Ontha has been sanctioned under DDC grant and accordingly work was started after the allotment to the contractor on the direction of concerned DDC on the said route.

However, after receiving call from Petitioner No.
1-Hukam Chand, they have stopped the work and communicated the same to the said petitioner on 02.11.2023.

3. Mr. A S Kotwal, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners seeks withdrawal of the instant petition, as the grievance which has been projected by the petitioners in the instant petition has been redressed.

4. In light of the stand taken by Mr. Ravinder Gupta, learned AAG in the aforementioned communication and the submissions made hereinabove, the instant petition along with connected CMs, if any, is accordingly dismissed as withdrawn.
However, petitioner would be at liberty to file fresh writ petition on the accrual of the fresh cause of action, if any.

(Wasim Sadiq Nargal) Judge JAMMU 18.11.2023 Manan Hukam Chand Basotra S/O Assanand vs Ut Of J & K Through Its Commissioner on 18 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/158471902/
